Copy the second-stage U-Boot script into the boot tree.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set unless `before` or
`after` constraints require otherwise. Dependencies include other recipes
without ordering them.

## Behavior

Copies Rugix Bakery's bundled Raspberry Pi second-stage U-Boot script into the
layer's boot tree. The surrounding image assembly must supply the compatible
first-stage boot configuration.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/rpi-uboot-setup"]
```
